summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a 55% quarterly dividend reset to $0.1875 per share ($0.75 annualized), targeting ~$2.7 billion cumulative cash savings through 2028 for debt reduction. The company also announced removal of the DRIP discount effective October 1, 2026, to reduce dilution, and revised full-year guidance with a leverage target of 3.0x or lower by year-end 2028. Net loss of $1.8 billion included a $2.1 billion goodwill impairment. This capital return reduction and DRIP change constitute a special-situation capital allocation event.
